Innovative & Customer Driven About Us | Analytical Sales and Services, Inc. Innovative & Customer Driven Analytical Sales and Services focuses on the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries, working primarily with research and development teams to derive innovative solutions, from small consumables to complex pieces of electronic equipment. Contact Analytical Solving real-world problems based on firsthand interactions with scientists in the lab. Our Facilities Our corporate headquarters are located on seven acres in Flanders, New Jersey. All operations, including research and development, production, and laboratory support, are located on our 7-acre property. Heaters & Coolers: When it comes to temperature control, we lead the industry with solutions, including AgileSLEEVE+, HotSLEEVE™️, ColdSLEEVE™️and others. Photoredox Catalysis & Parallel Synthesis: For the past decade, Analytical has been at the forefront of designing and manufacturing aluminum reaction blocks and 96-well LED arrays and lamps with the Lumidox. Flexible Tubing & Assemblies: FlexChrom® is a pre-finished stainless steel tube handling pressures up to 27,000psi made by hand onsite in our Flanders, NJ headquarters. New Products Developed and Manufactured Locally We pride ourselves on solving problems for the life science community utilizing our experience and determination. Our efficient team gets to work quickly developing solutions for real-life hurdles in the lab. Analytical takes pride in providing primarily domestically manufactured goods, many produced in the New York Metropolitan area, keeping our supply chain quick and dependable.
